correctness.rationale: Every derivation has unique diagonal-cocycle-plus-radical-inner decomposition. For D²=D, kerD surjects onto A/J, enabling characteristic-independent lifting of all coordinate idempotents within the kernel and radical-unit conjugation to a diagonal cocycle. Idempotence forces exactly 0/1 eigenvalues. Center(A)∩J=0 makes the stabilizer kerδα∩U and its size q^{m-w}; ranks follow by conjugation. 12 fully enumerated small-field cases independently form D matrices, compute D², and match exact rank histograms. Finite verification does not establish the universal statement, which is proved algebraically.

value.rationale: Projection derivations form a nonlinear natural subvariety of the full derivation space. The theorem supplies a complete rank-by-rank count and conjugacy classification for every finite-poset incidence algebra, including outer cocycles not representable by diagonal commutators. The mod-two orbit number detects first cohomology of the order complex; for crown posets it produces 16 distinct cocycle orbits and a (1+qT)^4 rank polynomial. These are motivated structural/arithmetic invariants unavailable from the total dimension of Der(A) alone.
